I need to identify which European country has the Lord Advocate as its chief law officer.

The Lord Advocate is the chief law officer of Scotland, which is part of the United Kingdom. The Lord Advocate serves as the head of the systems of criminal prosecution and investigation of deaths in Scotland.

Answer: Scotland (United Kingdom)
